title: Strict polynomial-size circuit class
statement: A Boolean language belongs to the strict polynomial-size circuit class if there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that it belongs to the strict size class with bound $n\mapsto a(n+1)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: Membership in the strict size class with bound $a(n+1)^k$
